name: Gerhard
source:
Leader of the Kairyuu Knight Troupe.
A hearty man who is proud of his strength, a former pirate.
His younger sister [url=/c43971]Maria[/url] and his former pirate buddies are also part of his troupe so it feels right at home for him.
Because of his simple and kindhearted nature he's an easy mark for [url=/c43958]Giovanni[/url].
He's not used to dealing with women.
